title: CyriPanel: CYP2D6 genotyping from targeted capture panels
description:
CyriPanel genotypes CYP2D6 star alleles from targeted capture sequencing. It adapts the paralog-aware framework of Cyrius and the BCyrius allele table, and estimates copy number against diploid reference samples sequenced with the same assay.

This release supports the manuscript CyriPanel for CYP2D6 Genotyping from Targeted Capture Panels Using Assay-Matched Diploid References. The benchmark/ directory holds the reference-standard diplotypes, the per-evaluation results for CyriPanel and Aldy 4, and the analysis scripts. benchmark/README.md lists the script or data source behind each table.

CyriPanel is research software. The benchmark measured analytical concordance in reference cell lines and is not a clinical validation.
notes: Relative to v1.0.1, this version adds a tested Conda environment, an executable two-sample example, archive installation and three benchmark reconstruction scripts. The R wrapper imports all 784 BED intervals with skip=0 and uses preinstalled CNVPanelizer 1.30.0. The original v1.0.1 evaluation CSV bytes are retained for the revised reconstruction. The earlier main benchmark tree is preserved in benchmark/legacy_main_7a1b0ea. Documentation, license attribution and a generic Slurm template are included. The full 116-sample BAM benchmark was not rerun.
